name: Kamihitoe no Omoibito
source:
A high school student, Satoshi Kurume, who was born and raised in a family whose livelihood is devilishness.
Although he grew up receiving demon extermination and demon extermination from his father, few people nowadays believe in "unscientific" things such as spirits and youkai. I didn't really care about it.

Meanwhile, Arashi Yuri, a college student who newly joined as a colleague at a part-time job, feels uncomfortable.

(I feel like I have something ...)

Arashi, who is a type that is easy to be possessed, happened to be her sister, Ritsuka's, boyfriend.
When Ritsuka, who is away from her hometown, asks for Arashi, she will watch over Arashi as a devilish master.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/27064]Freem![/url]]
translation:
高中生久留米聪，出生并成长于一个以恶魔为生的家庭。
虽然他从小就接受着父亲的降妖除魔，但现在已经很少有人相信鬼魂、妖怪等“不科学”的东西了。我真的不太关心它。

与此同时，刚加入兼职同事的大学生岚由里感到不舒服。

（我感觉我有一些东西……）岚是个容易被附体的类型，而她恰好是姐姐立香的男朋友。
当远在他乡的立香向岚求助时，她会以恶魔主人的身份守护着岚。
